**Direct answer:** Global semiconductor sales hit a record in 2024. The finalized figure is about $630.5 billion, up 19.7% from 2023. SIA first reported $627.6 billion, up 19.1%, in February 2025. WSTS later revised the total upward. Forecasts and regional growth rates are different numbers and shouldn't be confused with this one.

**Claims and sources**

- SIA announced 2024 sales of $627.6B, up 19.1% from $526.8B in 2023. This was the highest-ever annual total and the first above $600B. This was the preliminary figure, published Feb. 7, 2025.
  - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- SIA's page carries an update: WSTS revised 2024 year-end sales to $630.5B.
  - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- The WSTS Spring 2025 release lists the 2024 world total as $630,549M, up 19.7%. This is the finalized actual.
  - https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf
- Logic was the largest category at $212.6B. Memory grew 78.9% to $165.1B, and DRAM grew 82.6%.
  - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/
- The WSTS Fall 2024 forecast for 2024 was $627B, up 19.0%. It was made before the year ended, so it is an estimate and not a result.
  - https://www.wsts.org/76/103/WSTS-Semiconductor-Market-Forecast-Fall-2024
- Regional rates are sub-totals and differ widely from the global rate. In WSTS's Spring 2025 table, 2024 growth was:
  - Americas: +45.2%
  - Asia Pacific: +16.4%
  - Japan: 0.0%
  - Europe: −8.1%
  - https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf
- The Fall 2024 forecast had different regional rates: Americas +38.9%, Asia Pacific +17.5%, Japan +1.4%, Europe −6.7%. Regional forecasts shifted as actual data arrived.
  - https://www.wsts.org/76/103/WSTS-Semiconductor-Market-Forecast-Fall-2024
- The 2025 figure of $700.9B (+11.2%) and the 2026 figure of $760.7B (+8.5%) in the same Spring 2025 release are projections. The 2024 column in that table is the actual.
  - https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf

**How to tell them apart**

1. **Finalized annual figure.** Use the latest WSTS or SIA reported actual global total, which is $630.5B (+19.7%) for 2024. Check for revisions, because the first announcement ($627.6B, +19.1%) was later changed.
2. **Forecasts.** These are labeled as forecasts, projections or estimates (for example "Fall 2024 forecast", "projected"). They are made before the year closes or for future years.
3. **Regional growth rates.** These apply to one region and are not the global rate. Americas at +45.2% and Europe at −8.1% both sit alongside the +19.7% world figure.

**Caveats**
- Each key number rests on a single source: SIA for the preliminary figure and WSTS for the revised one. I found no independent corroboration within the retrieval limit.
- The WSTS Spring 2025 release is the only source I read for the +19.7% figure and the regional actuals. I did not open a later release to check whether they were revised again.
- A web search summary mentioned that a later WSTS release also shows $630,549M for 2024. I did not read that release myself, so I haven't relied on it.
- I found no evidence against the record-year finding.

Sources:
- [SIA press release](https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/)
- [WSTS Spring 2025 release (PDF)](https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf)
- [WSTS Fall 2024 forecast](https://www.wsts.org/76/103/WSTS-Semiconductor-Market-Forecast-Fall-2024)
